summary: Officer D. Reyes investigated a grand theft at Bay Area Electronics, located at 3200 Lakeshore Boulevard, Oakland, on March 22, 2024. The theft followed a pattern consistent with organized retail crime: a female suspect (white, 25-30, light hair, dark green jacket) created a distraction by engaging store employee Maria Santos with warranty inquiries, while a male accomplice (white, short hair, gray top) bypassed the security on the rear display case using what is believed to be a magnetic key. Four iPhone 15 Pro handsets were taken, with a combined retail value of $3,996. The pair escaped through the store's rear emergency exit onto Rand Avenue and were last seen by customer George Patterson entering a light-colored SUV heading north. Store manager Henry Yamamoto expressed concern about escalating organized theft at his location. This incident preceded and appears connected to a subsequent theft at the same store documented in Case #2024-00378, with near-identical tactics and suspect descriptions. Detective A. Morales of Property Crimes is leading the investigation.
